properties.NAME: Bexar Land Dist.
properties.CHANGE: Bexar Land District lost to creation of Young Territory; area north of Young Territory became known as Bexar Territory or Unorganized Territory in contemporary maps.
properties.CITATION: (Texas Laws 1856, 6th leg., adj. sess., ch. 110/p. 41; Colton, New Map of the State of Texas; Martin and Martin, Maps of Texas, 154-155, 158-159)
